answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 44944 Country: IR Title: Janazah Salah Question: Can we attend janazah salah without wudhu or tayammum if there is no water available? Answer ID: 44944 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 577/461/H=1434) If water is not available within one mile then you should join the salah by doing tayammum. However, janazah salah shall not be valid without wudhu if you are able to do wudhu, but if you are not able to do wudhu then Janazah salah shall not be valid without tayammum. If in case of doing wudhu there is possibility that janazah salah shall be missed then it is lawful to do tayammum for janazah salah though water is available. [N] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
